# GitHub Copilot instructions

Follow the repository-wide instructions in `AGENTS.md`.

## Code review rules

Always load `.agents/skills/thermo-nuclear-code-quality-review/SKILL.md` and apply its rules for code and pull request reviews.

## Skill selection

Use the `unslop` skill when editing Markdown, documentation, or prose to remove generic AI writing patterns. Scenario tags `#unslop`, `#writing`, `#documentation`, `#code-review`, `#pr-review`, and `#maintainability` are routing hints, not prerequisites.
